name: univent-college-event-management-system
description: Univent - Real-Time College Event Management System (MERN Stack microservices)

scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,EVENT,NOTIF,LEADER,SETTING" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,gray" "node backend/gateway/server.js" "node backend/auth-service/server.js" "node backend/event-service/server.js" "node backend/notification-service/server.js" "node backend/leaderboard-service/server.js" "node backend/settings-service/server.js"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "FRONTEND,GATEWAY,AUTH,EVENT,NOTIF,LEADER,SETTING" -c "red,magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,gray" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "node backend/gateway/server.js" "node backend/auth-service/server.js" "node backend/event-service/server.js" "node backend/notification-service/server.js" "node backend/leaderboard-service/server.js" "node backend/settings-service/server.js"
